title: Stellar Protocol Canary project configuration, version 1
description: The `.stellar-canary.toml` contract, validated against the Rust loader in `crates/canary-config`. Unlike the report and inventory schemas this one is closed: every table sets `additionalProperties: false`, because the loader uses `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` and a silently ignored key could drop a pin or disable nothing at all. A TOML file is converted to JSON (tables to objects, integers to integers, booleans to booleans, and a date, which no key of this file accepts, to null so that both sides refuse it) before validation. `crates/canary-config/tests/schema_parity.rs` pins the two sides together: nothing the schema accepts is something the loader refuses, and the only divergence it allows runs the other way — a `network`, `rpc_url` or `fixtures_dir` shape this file documents but the loader stores verbatim, so that an explicit `--network`/`--rpc-url`/`--fixtures-dir` still outranks a bad stored value (issue #474) while an editor or a CI job sees the shape error first (issue #455). `crates/canary-config/tests/schema.rs` holds this schema's own accept-and-reject unit tests.

version.description: The configuration format version. `canary_config::loader::validate` rejects any other value as an unsupported version, so this schema accepts exactly the version it documents.

protocol.description: The target Stellar protocol version for this project. Required, and zero is rejected by the loader as an invalid configuration rather than a parse failure. The range is the loader's `u32`.

network.description: The network live checks run against: `testnet`, `mainnet`, `futurenet`, or a custom name. Optional; absent means the CLI decides, cascading `--network` over the built-in `testnet` default. A name is one token: it starts alphanumeric and continues with letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`. The loader stores the string verbatim, so an unusable name only surfaces at run time; the pattern here is what an editor or a CI gate reports first.

rpc_url.description: The Stellar RPC endpoint for live checks, for example `https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org`. Optional; absent means the CLI decides, cascading `--rpc-url` over the resolved network's built-in default. Must be an absolute `http` or `https` URL with a non-empty remainder after `://` made only of URL characters, so whitespace, a double quote and an angle bracket are all invalid; another scheme such as `ftp://`, and an authority-less `https://`, is not a configuration value. A bracketed IPv6 literal (`http://[::1]:8000`) is outside this pattern. The loader performs no scheme or reachability check and stores the value verbatim, because a bad stored value must not stop a valid `--rpc-url` from winning; this schema is where the endpoint shape is pinned.

fixtures_dir.description: The directory holding fixture files, relative to the project root, for example `fixtures` or `tests/fixtures`. Optional; absent means the CLI decides, cascading `--fixtures-dir` over the built-in `fixtures` default. Must be a non-empty relative path: segments of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `~`, `%`, `+`, `-`, spaces and `/` or `\` separators. It may not start with a separator and may not carry a drive prefix, so an absolute path is not a value for this key — name one with `--fixtures-dir`. The loader turns the string into an operating-system path without checking it, so a path the platform happens to accept but this file does not document is a runtime finding, not a schema one.

project.description: How to classify the project under test. Optional; every member has a default, so an absent table means `type = "auto"`.

type.description: `auto` runs the built-in detection; any other value overrides it with a user-declared project type. The strings are the loader's `ProjectTypeSetting`, and the five explicit ones are the `canary_core::ProjectType` names.

tests.description: Which surfaces are enabled for this project. Optional; an absent member defaults to `true`, exactly as the loader's `#[serde(default = "default_true")]` does.

xdr.description: Enable the offline XDR surface. Defaults to true.

rpc.description: Enable the live RPC surface. Defaults to true.

soroban.description: Enable the Soroban simulation surface. Defaults to true.

not.description: The loader's cross-field rule: a configuration that turns every surface off is invalid, because a run that executes nothing cannot claim to have checked anything. Only the case where all three are explicitly false is rejected; leaving any of them absent keeps its default of true.

policy.description: How results turn into the pass/warning/fail decision. Optional; every member defaults to false.

warnings_are_failures.description: Treat warning results as failures for the overall status and exit code. Defaults to false.
